toast.undo.description: Button on the banner drawn inside a web page right after a one-click send. Pressing it cancels the send during the 4 seconds before it leaves. Short.

toast.undone.description: Headline of the in-page banner after the person pressed Undo and the send was cancelled.

toast.couldntSend.description: Headline of the banner when a one-click send has nothing to send. The line below it is toast.nothingSendable.

toast.nothingSendable.message: There's nothing sendable in this tab.
toast.nothingSendable.description: Second line of the banner when the current tab has no web page that can be sent (for example a blank tab). “Tab” is a browser tab.

toast.relayReachableAgain.description: Second line of the banner when tabs that were held back have been sent, after the relay (the server that passes tabs between devices) was unreachable.
